integrity: Theorem is proved analytically. Deterministic tests are supplementary; no independent audit has been performed.
limitations: No recolonization, birth or recovery; exponential independent local clocks and a single perfectly synchronous shock; finite-horizon k-of-n occupancy only; equally hazardous patches. Historical priority not independently confirmed because directly relevant 2015/2016 full texts are unavailable.
title: Universal single-crossing of habitat-quorum survival under synchronized mortality
